pois.name: Tranquility Base
pois.summary: Apollo 11 landing site in southwestern Mare Tranquillitatis, formally named Statio Tranquillitatis. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked here on 20 July 1969, the first crewed landing on another world.

pois.name: Tycho
pois.summary: Prominent young impact crater in the southern lunar highlands, about 85 km wide with a bright ray system that stretches across much of the near side. Its sharp rim and central peak make it a classic telescopic landmark.
